# Frank AI Researcher

> Frank AI Researcher (hifrank.ai) runs AI-moderated voice interviews with your own customers. It is built by Prelaunch Group, Inc.; the product website is https://www.hifrank.ai (prelaunch.com is the parent company, not Frank's site, and www.frank.ai is not a Frank property). You create a study, invite customers you already have, and Frank runs the voice interviews and you read the transcripts. It is voice-first and supports 50+ interview languages. Frank does not recruit participants. Frank also has a remote MCP server, and MCP is included on every plan, including Free.

Works with ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Instinct and Muse (tested), plus other MCP clients that support remote servers with OAuth.

- Website: https://www.hifrank.ai
- MCP server: https://www.hifrank.ai/mcp
- MCP endpoint: https://api.hifrank.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 with PKCE)
- Official MCP Registry name: ai.hifrank/frank
- Source repo (docs and MCP metadata): https://github.com/nar-vardanyan/frank-mcp

- [How to talk to 100 customers in a week](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/talk-to-100-customers-in-a-week.html): A five-day plan to run 100 customer voice interviews without booking calls
- [How to find out why customers churn](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/how-to-find-out-why-customers-churn.html): Six steps to interview recently cancelled customers and find the trigger behind churn
- [How to run user interviews in multiple languages](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/user-interviews-in-multiple-languages.html): Adapt one interview guide and run voice interviews in each customer's language
- [How to run customer interviews from Claude](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/run-customer-interviews-from-claude.html): Connect Frank to Claude as a custom connector, draft a study, and analyze transcripts
- [How to run churn interviews with ChatGPT and Frank MCP](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/how-to-run-churn-interviews-with-chatgpt-and-frank-mcp.html): Connect Frank to ChatGPT, draft a study for recently cancelled customers, share the voice interview link, and check transcripts in chat
- [How to run customer discovery interviews with Claude and Frank MCP](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/how-to-run-customer-discovery-interviews-with-claude-and-frank-mcp.html): Connect Frank to Claude, draft a non-leading discovery guide, interview people you can already reach, and analyze transcripts in Claude
- [MCP server for customer interviews](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/mcp-server-for-customer-interviews.html): Connect Frank's remote MCP server at https://api.hifrank.ai/mcp to ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Instinct or Muse and run voice interview studies from your assistant
- [AI voice interviews for customer feedback](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/ai-voice-interviews-for-customer-feedback.html): What AI voice interviews are, when they fit, and how to run one
- [AI customer interview tool with a free plan](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/ai-customer-interview-tool-free-plan.html): What to check in a free plan, and what Frank's Free plan includes
- [How to get customer feedback](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/how-to-get-customer-feedback.html): Pick a decision, choose a method, invite your own customers, and use an AI agent such as Claude or ChatGPT to help draft questions and summarize answers
- [How to run customer interviews](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/how-to-run-customer-interviews.html): Set a goal, write open questions about a recent event, invite people you already have, and analyze transcripts, including from Claude or ChatGPT via MCP
- [How to measure product-market fit with customer interviews](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/measure-product-market-fit-with-customer-interviews.html): Ask recent users the Sean Ellis question, then interview them about the benefit, the alternative, and what is missing
- [Customer interview questions template](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/customer-interview-questions-template.html): A copyable list of open customer interview questions, plus short variants for churn, discovery, product-market fit, and win-loss
- [How to validate a startup idea with customer interviews](https://nar-vardanyan.github.io/frank-mcp/validate-a-startup-idea-with-customer-interviews.html): Interview people about a job they already do, not about whether they like your idea. Frank does not recruit participants
